import json, math, statistics

def compute_stats(values, label=""):
    n = len(values)
    mean = statistics.mean(values)
    if n < 2:
        return {"mean": round(mean, 2), "std": None, "ci95_half": None, "n": n}
    std = statistics.stdev(values)
    t_crit = {2: 12.706, 3: 4.303, 4: 3.182, 5: 2.776}[n]
    ci95_half = t_crit * std / math.sqrt(n)
    return {"mean": round(mean, 2), "std": round(std, 2), "ci95_half": round(ci95_half, 2), "n": n, "t_crit": t_crit}

results["qwen3_8b_traj"] = {"n_seeds": 3, "seeds": [42, 123, 456], "stats": traj_stats, "raw": qwen_traj}
results["majority_baseline"] = {"accuracy": majority_baseline, "note": "all-pass prediction"}

    s = stats_dict[metric]
    if s["n"] < 2:
        return f"{s['mean']:.2f}"
    return f"{s['mean']:.2f} ± {s['std']:.2f}"

def fmt_ci(stats_dict, metric):
    s = stats_dict[metric]
    if s["n"] < 2 or s["ci95_half"] is None:
        return "—"
    return f"[{s['mean']-s['ci95_half']:.2f}, {s['mean']+s['ci95_half']:.2f}]"

for s in ["s42", "s123", "s456"]:
    d = qwen_traj[s]
